description:
Join Clay Stone, Josh Greenfield, Ana Resendez, and Kris Zierhut as they share how this fully new World of Warcraft game is set in a reimagined, original Azeroth and is being shaped around the moments that make the world feel alive.

🔥 Join players around the Basic Campfire for useful benefits
📚 Every journey comes with rewards with the Legacy System
🌐 Play together in a realmless Azeroth; just pick the ruleset and log in!
➕ And so much more!

Take new first steps through lands untrodden when World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, 2026. Or, uncover Azeroth’s mysteries early by playing in the WoW: Forever Beta starting September 17, 2026, when you pre-purchase the Skyborne Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection.
